tools.name: GetSystemPrompt
tools.description: Returns a compact markdown context block describing the repository for use as an AI agent system prompt.

inputSchema.title: GetSystemPrompt
inputSchema.description: Returns a compact markdown context block describing the repository for use as an AI agent system prompt.

tools.name: GenerateDesignDocument
tools.description: Generates design documents containing Mermaid diagrams (class diagrams or dependency/flow graphs) for a given symbol to visualize architecture.

inputSchema.title: GenerateDesignDocument
inputSchema.description: Generates design documents containing Mermaid diagrams (class diagrams or dependency/flow graphs) for a given symbol to visualize architecture.

diagramType.description: Type of diagram: 'class' (for class structures and inheritance) or 'flow' (for dependencies, calls, and workflow)

symbolName.description: The exact or partial name of the class, module, or symbol to diagram.

depth.description: Depth of relations to traverse. Default is 1 for class, 2 for flow. Use -1 for auto.

tools.name: GetCodeGraph
tools.description: Returns the full repository code graph as compact JSON for AI agent context. Automatically compresses if over token budget.

inputSchema.title: GetCodeGraph
inputSchema.description: Returns the full repository code graph as compact JSON for AI agent context. Automatically compresses if over token budget.

tools.name: GetSymbol
tools.description: Searches for a symbol by name and returns its definition, file location, connected symbols with names, and code snippet.

inputSchema.title: GetSymbol
inputSchema.description: Searches for a symbol by name and returns its definition, file location, connected symbols with names, and code snippet.

symbolName.description: Symbol name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive)

tools.name: GetFileContext
tools.description: Returns all nodes and edges for a specific file path, including connected nodes up to hopDepth hops away. Accepts both relative and absolute paths.

inputSchema.title: GetFileContext
inputSchema.description: Returns all nodes and edges for a specific file path, including connected nodes up to hopDepth hops away. Accepts both relative and absolute paths.

hopDepth.description: Number of hops to traverse from the file's nodes. Default 2.
